_raised.note: The five-step application walked END TO END for the first time: Applicant -> Address & Employment -> Coverage -> Health -> Review & Submit, four advances, every one taken at tier 1. The Health step was the last block - eight condition checkboxes whose 'select at least one' rule exists only in the app's own script and cannot be written in HTML - and it was cleared by answering one question and letting the application re-render its own verdict on Continue. THE FLOORS LIVE IN THIS REPO FILE, NOT ON THE VM: deploy overwrites the VM copy from git, so a rise recorded only on the VM is silently forgotten on the next deploy. Two earlier rises (pages 21, deepest_flow 4, wizard_advances 3) were lost exactly that way.

_rebaselined.reason: The previous floors were seeded from a BROKEN funnel. Before the danger-scope fix the crawler could not advance the wizard, so it recorded each step as an unrelated one-step flow and re-submitted the same form repeatedly - 11 submits for a form that is submitted once. Walking the funnel properly consolidates those fragments into one 3-deep journey, which necessarily lowers the page, flow, submit and test counts while strictly improving the result. Verified before lowering: seq 1 captured the Applicant step (Gender, names, DOB, SSN, email, phone) and seq 2 captured Address & Employment (street, city, state, ZIP, occupation, employer, income) - seven fields that had NEVER been captured before. deepest_flow 1->3 and wizard_advances 0->2 are the same change seen from the other side. Left as floors so a future regression below the consolidated numbers still fails.

_rebaselined_2026_08_31.reason: ONE STEP RECLASSIFIED, VERIFIED IN THE FLOW RECORD BEFORE LOWERING. The wizard's final step used to be counted as its fifth advance; the engine at 46f9460 records that page as the flow's SUBMIT BOUNDARY (terminal=submit_boundary, completed=true, 4 steps) and then CROSSES it through the attested submit path - which the old engine could not do here at all. The same crawl measured boundaries_crossed=14 and forms_confirmed 0->5 (a floor that had been zero for the product's entire life), plus rises in pages 22->32, forms 7->8, auto_filled 29->33, selects_filled 10->11, submitted 9->14, flows 7->13, tests 9->23 and catalog_questions 67->83. deepest_flow 5->4 and wizard_advances 4->3 are that one reclassified step seen from the other side - the funnel went strictly forward while the counting became honest. Left as floors so a regression below the reclassified numbers still fails.
